meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration for omo-senpi. Scopes solo, ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live ulw-loop journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建研究团队,自动完成深度调研并产出带引用报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速完成一个多角度、带引用的深度研究报告
copy.tagline_en: Assemble a research team to run deep investigations and produce cited reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a thorough, multi-perspective research report with citations.

howto.what: 明确要求研究时，Claude 先询问交付格式（默认 PDF+DOCX），再组建最多 8 人的团队：每轴一名成员加怀疑/红队，通过辩论、探索、扩展循环穷尽线索，用代码验证有争议的主张，最终产出带引用、图表并通过视觉 QA 与校对的综合报告。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求研究时触发：说出“ulw-research”关键词、提出“ultradebate”式研究请求，或要求做深度研究/超精确调查（任何语言）。普通问题、调试不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深入研究一下向量数据库的优缺点
say.note: 会先问你要什么格式，然后组建团队开始饱和研究。

say.text: 启动 ultradebate，对比 Rust 和 Go 在云原生场景的取舍
say.note: 团队成员会相互辩论，并用代码验证关键论断。

say.text: 做一次深度研究：大模型推理成本优化，输出 PDF 和 DOCX
say.note: 默认产出 PDF+DOCX，先确认格式再开工。

howto.what_en: On explicit research demand, Claude asks output format (default PDF+DOCX), makes an 8-member team (per-axis + skeptic/red), debates/explores/EXPANDs, verifies contested claims by code, and delivers cited synthesis with charts, Mermaid, visual QA, proofread gates.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on explicit research demands: the keyword 'ulw-research', 'ultradebate'-style research requests, or explicit deep-research/ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Normal questions or debugging never activate it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to deeply investigate pros and cons of vector databases.
say_en.note: It will ask the format, then start saturation research.

say_en.text: Start ultradebate comparing Rust vs Go for cloud-native trade-offs.
say_en.note: Team members debate and verify claims with code.

say_en.text: Do a deep research on LLM inference cost optimization, output PDF and DOCX.
say_en.note: Default outputs are PDF+DOCX; format confirmed first.
